blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Cebu Provincial Board is asking power distributors and cooperatives to prepare backup measures as limited electricity supply continues to affect the Visayas grid. The move follows yellow and red alerts recorded in the Visayas grid in recent months, amid generating units taken offline and limited electricity sourced from the Mindanao Grid. First District Board Members Antonio Bacaltos Jr. and Lakambini Reluya filed the resolution, which the provincial board approved during its regular session on Sept. 14, 2026. It directed local power utilities and electric cooperatives to submit their contingency measures to the Office of the Governor […]...
